name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run the canary rollout at 5% traffic for the new prompt engine. It’s the fastest way to catch silent failures without risking user impact. The trade-off is delayed full deployment, but that’s better than a rollback under load.

name: Gauge
text: Canary at 5% still misses the real risk: silent failures only show up when users hit them, not when traffic is low. A better alternative is a shadow test that replays real user traffic against the new engine in parallel, comparing outputs before any traffic shift. Settle it with a controlled A/B where shadow results match production behavior within a tight tolerance—if they don’t, no rollout until the gap closes.
